title: 社会公德与文明风尚
desc: 汇集社会公德、文明礼仪、诚信、志愿助人与社会责任等社会风尚类作文高分表达

entries.example: Civic awareness is the foundation on which a well-ordered society ultimately rests.
entries.exampleZh: 公民意识是一个秩序良好的社会最终赖以存在的基础。
entries.note: 只作定语，常修饰 virtue、duty，比 public 更强调担当。

entries.example: Simple acts of civility, such as saying thank you, can warm an entire community.
entries.exampleZh: 简单的文明举动，比如道一声谢谢，就能温暖整个社区。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 show 搭配，比 politeness 书面。

entries.example: Observing basic etiquette in public places reflects a person's upbringing and cultivation.
entries.exampleZh: 在公共场所遵守基本礼仪体现了一个人的教养与修养。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 observe、violate 搭配，无复数。

entries.example: Courtesy costs nothing, yet it can defuse conflicts and win lasting respect.
entries.exampleZh: 礼貌不费分文，却能化解冲突、赢得持久的尊重。
entries.note: 不可数；by courtesy 意为出于礼貌，亦可用 courteous。

entries.example: Uncivilized conduct such as spitting in public tarnishes the image of a modern city.
entries.exampleZh: 在公共场所随地吐痰等不文明行为损害了一座现代城市的形象。
entries.note: 常修饰 conduct、behavior，比 bad 更具体有力。

entries.example: Tourists who litter scenic spots spoil the experience for everyone who follows.
entries.exampleZh: 在景区乱扔垃圾的游客破坏了后来所有人的体验。
entries.note: 及物或不及物均可；名词不可数，如 drop litter。

entries.example: Jaywalking not only endangers pedestrians' lives but also disrupts the traffic order.
entries.exampleZh: 乱穿马路不仅危及行人生命，也扰乱交通秩序。
entries.note: 常用动名词 jaywalking 作主语；拼写为一个词。

entries.example: Vandalism in public parks forces local governments to spend heavily on repairs.
entries.exampleZh: 公园里破坏公物的行为迫使地方政府在维修上花费巨资。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 commit、combat 搭配，谈公物保护。

entries.zh: 不体谅他人的；不替他人着想的
entries.example: Playing loud music on a night train is deeply inconsiderate to fellow passengers.
entries.exampleZh: 在夜间列车上大声放音乐，对同行乘客极为不体谅。
entries.note: 后接 of 或 to 引出对象；反义 considerate。

entries.example: Integrity is the most valuable asset a person can possess and the hardest to regain.
entries.exampleZh: 诚信是一个人能拥有的最宝贵资产，也是最难重新获得的。
entries.note: 不可数；谈诚信话题的核心词，常用作主语。

entries.example: Once a company loses credibility, no advertisement can restore customers' trust.
entries.exampleZh: 一家公司一旦失去信誉，任何广告都无法恢复顾客的信任。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 lose、enhance 搭配，谈失信话题。

entries.example: Empathy enables us to sense another person's pain and respond with genuine kindness.
entries.exampleZh: 同理心使我们能感知他人的痛苦并以真诚的善意回应。
entries.note: 不可数；搭配 empathy with sb，勿与 sympathy 混用。

entries.example: Tolerance of different opinions is the hallmark of a mature and open society.
entries.exampleZh: 对不同意见的宽容是一个成熟开放社会的标志。
entries.note: 不可数；搭配 tolerance of sth，形容词 tolerant。

entries.example: Every citizen has an obligation to keep public spaces clean and safe.
entries.exampleZh: 每个公民都有保持公共空间清洁安全的义务。
entries.note: 可数名词，常用 an obligation to do sth。

entries.example: A community's ethos is shaped less by written rules than by everyday behavior.
entries.exampleZh: 一个社区的风气与其说由成文规则塑造，不如说由日常行为塑造。
entries.note: 单数不可数；social ethos 即社会风气。

entries.example: Shared public values strengthen the cohesion of a society composed of diverse groups.
entries.exampleZh: 共同的公共价值观增强了由多元群体构成的社会凝聚力。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 social 连用，谈团结互助话题。

entries.example: A harmonious neighborhood does not happen by accident; it requires everyone's effort.
entries.exampleZh: 和谐的邻里关系不是偶然形成的，它需要每个人的努力。
entries.note: 作定语或表语，常修饰 society；勿与 harmony 重复。

entries.example: Her exemplary conduct during the flood rescue inspired the whole neighborhood.
entries.exampleZh: 她在抗洪救援中的模范行为激励了整个社区。
entries.note: 作定语，常修饰 conduct、citizen，褒义色彩强。

entries.example: Stricter fines may help curb jaywalking, but education works far more deeply.
entries.exampleZh: 更严厉的罚款或许有助于遏制乱穿马路，但教育的作用要深远得多。
entries.note: 及物动词，接 littering、vandalism 等行为名词。

entries.example: Schools should foster in students a genuine respect for public property.
entries.exampleZh: 学校应培养学生对公共财物发自内心的尊重。
entries.note: 可接 foster sth in sb；常搭配 climate。

entries.example: Volunteering cultivates patience and a sense of social responsibility in young people.
entries.exampleZh: 志愿服务培养年轻人的耐心和社会责任感。
entries.note: 及物动词，宾语多为 habit、virtue，与 foster 近义。

entries.example: Public morality declines not because rules are absent, but because they are ignored.
entries.exampleZh: 公共道德的滑坡不是因为缺乏规则，而是因为规则被无视。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 uphold、decline 搭配，作总起表达。

entries.example: Civic virtue means doing the right thing even when nobody is watching.
entries.exampleZh: 公民美德意味着即使无人注视也做正确的事。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 practice、cultivate 连用，比 good 正式。

entries.example: Civilized behavior in public begins with small habits like queuing and lowering one's voice.
entries.exampleZh: 公共场所的文明行为始于排队、压低声音这样的小习惯。
entries.note: 不可数；与 uncivilized conduct 正反对比论证。

entries.example: Good manners open doors that wealth and talent alone can never open.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的举止能打开仅凭财富与才华永远打不开的门。
entries.note: 固定用复数，不可写成 good manner；与 show 搭配。

entries.example: Queue-jumping annoys everyone around and reveals a lack of respect for others.
entries.exampleZh: 插队惹恼周围的每个人，暴露出对他人的缺乏尊重。
entries.note: 英式说法，美式为 cutting in line；主语谓语用单数。

entries.example: Businesses that break their promises may save money today but lose customers tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 违背承诺的企业今天或许省了钱，明天却会失去顾客。
entries.note: one's 须与主语一致；同义 go back on one's word。

entries.example: When a stranger stumbles on the street, we should lend a helping hand without hesitation.
entries.exampleZh: 当陌生人在街上跌倒时，我们应毫不犹豫地伸出援手。
entries.note: 固定搭配 lend sb a helping hand，叙述图画好用。

entries.example: Voluntary work in nursing homes teaches teenagers compassion that textbooks never can.
entries.exampleZh: 养老院的志愿工作教给青少年教科书永远教不会的同情心。
entries.note: 不可数；也可说 voluntary service，与 do 搭配。

entries.example: Many retired teachers dedicate themselves to tutoring children in remote mountain villages.
entries.exampleZh: 许多退休教师致力于为偏远山村的孩子辅导功课。
entries.note: to 为介词，后接名词或动名词；亦作 dedicated to。

entries.example: Community service not only helps those in need but also strengthens neighborhood ties.
entries.exampleZh: 社区服务不仅帮助需要帮助的人，也加强邻里纽带。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 do、perform 搭配，属公益话题。

entries.example: Mutual respect is the invisible thread that keeps strangers living side by side in peace.
entries.exampleZh: 相互尊重是把比邻而居的陌生人维系在和平之中的无形纽带。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 build、promote 搭配，作论点句。

entries.example: We should be considerate of the elderly and offer our seats on crowded buses.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应体谅老年人，在拥挤的公交车上主动让座。
entries.note: 介词用 of，间或可用 to；名词为 consideration。

entries.example: Only by putting ourselves in others' shoes can we truly understand their difficulties.
entries.exampleZh: 只有设身处地为他人着想，我们才能真正理解他们的难处。
entries.note: 习语，shoe 须用复数；论证同理心最常用。

entries.en: respect the elderly and care for the young
entries.example: Respecting the elderly and caring for the young is a tradition deeply rooted in Chinese culture.
entries.exampleZh: 尊老爱幼是深深植根于中国文化中的传统。
entries.note: 作主语时改为动名词，谓语用单数。

entries.example: A strong sense of responsibility drives ordinary people to do extraordinary things.
entries.exampleZh: 强烈的责任感驱使平凡的人做出不平凡的事。
entries.note: 常用 a sense of 结构；搭配 shoulder one's duty。

entries.example: Young people should shoulder their duty to care for the aging generation.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻人应担负起照顾老龄一代的责任。
entries.note: shoulder 作动词意为承担，常搭配 duty、burden。

entries.example: Everyone can contribute to society, no matter how modest his or her ability is.
entries.exampleZh: 无论能力多么微薄，每个人都能为社会作贡献。
entries.note: to 是介词；亦作 make contributions to。

entries.example: A harmonious society rests on mutual trust rather than on strict surveillance.
entries.exampleZh: 和谐社会建立在相互信任之上，而非严密监控之上。
entries.note: 常作主语或宾语，搭配 build a harmonious society。

entries.example: The authorities concerned should step up supervision over food safety in school canteens.
entries.exampleZh: 有关当局应加强对学校食堂食品安全的监管。
entries.note: 固定说法；concerned 必须后置，作主语提建议用。

entries.example: To protect personal data, the government should enact stricter regulations on its collection.
entries.exampleZh: 为保护个人数据，政府应对数据收集制定更严格的法规。
entries.note: enact 用于法规；常与 impose penalties 连用。

entries.example: To reduce littering, the city must take effective measures rather than rely on slogans.
entries.exampleZh: 为减少乱扔垃圾，城市必须采取有效措施，而不是依赖标语。
entries.note: 后接不定式 to do；也可用 take concrete steps。

entries.en: It is high time that we took concrete measures to ___.
entries.zh: 该是我们采取具体措施去…的时候了。
entries.example: It is high time that we took concrete measures to curb uncivilized conduct in public.
entries.exampleZh: 该是我们采取具体措施遏制公共场所不文明行为的时候了。
entries.note: 虚拟语气，从句谓语用过去式；结尾段首选。

entries.en: A harmonious society can hardly be built without ___.
entries.zh: 没有…，和谐社会几乎无法建成。
entries.example: A harmonious society can hardly be built without the joint efforts of every citizen.
entries.exampleZh: 没有每个公民的共同努力，和谐社会几乎无法建成。
entries.note: 双重否定表强调，without 后接名词或动名词。

entries.en: ___ should set a good example to others by ___.
entries.zh: …应以身作则，通过…为他人树立榜样。
entries.example: Public figures should set a good example to others by observing basic social etiquette.
entries.exampleZh: 公众人物应以身作则，遵守基本的社会礼仪。
entries.note: by 后接动名词；也可用 take the lead in doing。

entries.en: There is no denying that ___ has become a matter of public concern.
entries.zh: 不可否认，…已成为公众关注的问题。
entries.example: There is no denying that the decline of public morality has become a matter of public concern.
entries.exampleZh: 不可否认，公共道德的滑坡已成为公众关注的问题。
entries.note: 万能开头句，从句用现在完成时，不说 I think。

entries.en: Only when every citizen ___ can we ___.
entries.zh: 只有当每个公民…，我们才能…。
entries.example: Only when every citizen behaves with civility can we build a truly harmonious community.
entries.exampleZh: 只有每个公民都以礼行事，我们才能建设真正和谐的社区。
entries.note: only when 从句置句首时主句倒装；结尾段呼吁用。

entries.example: It is everyone's duty to protect public facilities as if they were their own property.
entries.exampleZh: 保护公共设施就像保护自己的财产一样，是每个人的责任。
entries.note: it 为形式主语，真正主语是不定式。

entries.en: Whether we can ___ depends largely on ___.
entries.zh: 我们能否…，很大程度上取决于…。
entries.example: Whether we can reverse this trend depends largely on the choices we make today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们能否扭转这一趋势，很大程度上取决于我们今天所做的选择。
entries.note: whether 引导主语从句，谓语用单数 depends。

entries.en: What we should bear in mind is that ___.
entries.example: What we should bear in mind is that public morality matters more than personal convenience.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应当牢记的是，社会公德比个人便利更重要。
entries.note: what 引导主语从句；结尾段总结升华，比 I think 客观。

entries.example: Instead of blaming others for a dirty city, we ought to start with our own behavior.
entries.exampleZh: 与其抱怨城市脏乱，我们不如从自身行为做起。
entries.note: instead of 后接动名词，ought to 后接动词原形。

entries.en: Never should we ___ at the expense of ___.
entries.zh: 我们绝不应以牺牲…为代价去…。
entries.example: Never should we pursue personal gain at the expense of public interests.
entries.exampleZh: 我们绝不应以牺牲公共利益为代价追求个人利益。
entries.note: 否定词置句首引起倒装；at the expense of 意为以…为代价。

entries.example: "Manners make the man," an old saying that still holds true in crowded modern cities.
entries.exampleZh: “举止造就人”，这句古老谚语在拥挤的现代都市中依然成立。
entries.note: 谈文明礼貌主题；作开头段引语，后接现象描述。

entries.en: "No man is an island." — John Donne
entries.zh: “没有人是一座孤岛。”——约翰·多恩
entries.example: As John Donne wrote, no man is an island; we all depend on one another.
entries.exampleZh: 正如约翰·多恩所写，没有人是一座孤岛，我们彼此依存。
entries.note: 谈互助与社会责任；引用后须接自己的阐释。

entries.en: "The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others." — Mahatma Gandhi
entries.zh: “发现自己最好的方式，就是把自己投入到为他人的服务中。”——圣雄甘地
entries.example: Gandhi's words remind us that the best way to find yourself is to serve others.
entries.exampleZh: 甘地的话提醒我们，发现自己最好的方式就是服务他人。
entries.note: 谈志愿精神与助人奉献，放结尾段提升立意。
